title: Assess and apply retirement of current-view material
description: Determines whether a proposed removal can preserve recoverable historical meaning and current dependencies, and records or carries out the permitted current-view retirement within its authorized scope. It does not treat current-view cleanup as release of retained history.
inputs: Retained recovery basis, active reliance, surviving obligations and consumers, and their proposed dispositions.
Applicable retention policy and authorization for the proposed action.
preconditions: The candidate material and selected project are identified.
outputs: Retirement readiness or identified unmet recovery, dependency, or authority conditions.
Recorded disposition and current-view removal outcome when the action is applicable and authorized.
behavior: Assess whether original content and meaning are recoverable and whether unretained work would be lost.
Identify active work, unresolved findings, current evidence, obligations, and consumers requiring retention, transfer, replacement, or explicit retirement.
Require reconciliation of surviving current reliance and applicable authorization before removing the material from the working view.
Record the disposition, recovery basis, affected scope, and actual outcome; preserve current operation without dependence on fetching retired definitions.
Treat release of retained history as a separate controlled retention-policy decision rather than an age-based consequence of cleanup.

Before retiring operational source files, current consumers and required evidence must have a coherent replacement or explicit disposition, and original content required for historical reliance remains recoverable. A successful import alone does not authorize deletion.

failure_behavior.condition: Historical recoverability or reconciliation of current reliance is unestablished.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold removal and identify the missing recovery basis or surviving dependency.

failure_behavior.condition: Authority is absent or the proposal would discard active or unresolved material without coherent replacement.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold the affected action and identify the specific boundary or unresolved reliance.
Report actual affected scope and remaining inconsistencies without claiming completed cleanup.

sources.basis: SR-024 confirms dependency-safe retirement under IR-003. SR-007 constrains destructive actions and policy changes; retained historical content is provided by the Baseline capability.

Propose MOD-006 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
Draft derivation from the refined IRs and RR proposal; no approval, implementation or satisfaction claim.
